title: Round 27 Gulf state-frame USGS GNIS source register
scope: All-GNIS starter registers for Mississippi and Alabama. Every seeded row reproduces one accepted USGS GNIS Geocoder candidate screened by exact official name, returned type/state/county, permanent FEATURE_ID, and returned primary point. Woodall Mountain, Cheaha Mountain, Guntersville Lake, and Wheeler Lake additionally carry GNIS Domestic Names per-ID checks.

usgsGeocoder.use: Fuzzy candidate discovery only. A candidate was accepted only when Name, Type, State, County, GnisId, Latitude, and Longitude all matched the intended feature. Counties, divisions, landings, canals, cut-offs, creeks, bayous, reservoirs, channels, ship channels, basins, heights, junctions, parks, branches, mountains, bars, estates, air fields, and same-name records of another class or county were rejected explicitly where relevant. Abbreviation variants (Ross R. versus Ross R) were screened and recorded.

gnisDomesticNames.use: Per-ID identity checks for Woodall Mountain (692362), confirming the Mississippi High Point description and variants; Cheaha Mountain (159374), confirming the Alabama High Point description, 1906 Board Decision, and variants; Guntersville Lake (119508 plus rejected parallel 1286448), confirming the decision cards; and Wheeler Lake (112837 plus rejected separate-feature 131097), confirming the 1954 decision card and dam-chain sequences.

selectionRules: VERIFIED=1 is claimed only for an exact official name, compatible GNIS feature class/type, intended state and returned primary county, permanent FEATURE_ID, and an official point returned by a cited USGS service.

Grouped Geocoder Types map explicitly to stored row classes: Cities & Populated Places to Populated Place, Lakes & Reservoirs to Lake for the accepted named lakes, Streams & Canals to Stream for the accepted river records, and Summit to Summit.
A stored GNIS primary point is never described as a municipal boundary, street-address geocode, generic centroid, shoreline polygon, summit outline, or river centerline.

If exact-name candidates remain indistinguishable, the state-filtered screen returns no intended feature record, the returned record does not match the intended name and type, or the returned primary point does not identify an in-frame reach of the intended feature, the feature is omitted from that state gazetteer and may appear only as a generalized context corridor.

When two official same-name records describe one feature, the record carrying the Board decision cards and the namesake primary map is stored and the parallel record is disclosed as a duplicate; when two same-name records are separate features, only the record identified as the intended feature by its decision card and namesake sequences may be stored.

Statewide frames use explicitly synthetic relief gaussians and generalized corridors; no bundled DEM or surveyed boundary is implied. Both frames ship labelled generalized Gulf coast lines that are not shoreline surveys.

mississippi.title: Mississippi statewide frame
mississippi.frameNote: Gulf batch: the Jackson, Gulfport, Biloxi, Hattiesburg, Tupelo, and Vicksburg anchors are balanced with per-ID Woodall Mountain (806 feet), Sardis and Ross R Barnett reservoirs, and the Yazoo, Big Black, and Pascagoula river records. The Mississippi River stays corridor-only after an empty states=MS screen following the Louisiana seed; Tombigbee is empty under MS, Pearl River returns only county/town/CDP records, and Grenada Lake holds to starter scope. The Jackson ten-record trap pile is recorded.

identityDecisions.decision: Seeded the Marshall County record 119508: its per-ID check shows the Board decision card PDFs (1952 and 1954), the Guntersville Reservoir variant name, Primary Map Guntersville Dam, and 19 sequences along the Tennessee River chain with sequence 1 at the dam matching this screen. The parallel Jackson County record 1286448 duplicates the same impoundment with 20 sequences and its own 1952 decision row but no decision cards; it is disclosed and not seeded as a second lake.
identityDecisions.knownServiceDiscrepancy: Two official same-name reservoir records describe one impoundment because the lake spans Jackson and Marshall counties; suggestion order listed 1286448 first. The decision-card rule picks 119508; neither record verifies the shoreline.

identityDecisions.decision: Seeded the Limestone County record 112837: its per-ID check shows the 1954 Board decision card PDF and 17 sequences along the Tennessee River chain including the Wheeler Dam sequence, with sequence 1 matching this screen. The Chambers County record 131097 (entered 2003, Primary Map Lafayette, point 32.9222321/-85.3879005 on the Georgia border) is a separate same-name lake and is rejected as not the intended Tennessee River reservoir.
identityDecisions.notClaimed: The rejected Chambers County lake is not verified or dismissed as a feature; it is simply not the intended one, and the stored point is not a shoreline.

knownLimitations: Mississippi and Alabama are starter registers, not statewide GNIS extracts. Each contains 12 deliberately selected identity-safe rows.

The USGS Geocoder is a suggestion service; exact-match screening by name/type/state/county/FEATURE_ID is part of the evidence, and the returned county is primary-county provenance. Woodall Mountain, Cheaha Mountain, Guntersville Lake, and Wheeler Lake additionally carry per-ID Domestic Names detail checks.

GNIS point data do not supply the displayed terrain or corridors. Both frames use explicitly synthetic relief gaussians and generalized context lines; the Gulf coast lines are generalized, not shoreline surveys.
State frames are rectangles, not state-boundary clipping masks. Both rectangles include small areas outside their state outlines; no boundary geometry is claimed.
